narratives.Description: test(flaky): #6904 tree-kill tests in ci-reuse.test.ts and the occupancy suite fail intermittently in the queue
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

Two tests fail intermittently in the merge queue and in `scope:complete`:

1. `packages/core/src/release/ci-reuse.test.ts`, describe "smoke command under the timed-child supervisor (#6904)". "stops a child that outlives the deadline and reports the tree stopped" (line 636) failed in merge-group runs 45105737860 (#7166 group) and 45106027256 (#7167 group) on 2026-11-23, each time the only failure in 1674 files. "still stops the child but reports unverified when the scan fails" (line 643) failed on a third queue run that night. Both tests take about 2.5 s of real time (Greptile flagged them against the slow-test rule, #975, on #6904's PR #7129). Each failure drops the PR out of the queue.
2. The occupancy acceptance suite fails intermittently when `scope:complete` runs it as an acceptance command (seen on the #6679 lifecycle, 2026-11-23). A re-run passes. Split out to #7195.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The two #6904 tree-kill tests stay real-process tests, with recorded Linux stress evidence: the liveness probe misread rate before and after the fix, and at least 90 test runs with no failure.
- [ ] Per `CONTRIBUTING.md` § Slow tests (#975) there is no slow marker; the real-process tree-kill proof is kept, and the fix removes the race rather than hiding it.

Refs #6904, #7129, #975, #6679.
